text:
Type: natural sheepskin rug
Use: soft throw on a floor, chair or bench; living room, bedroom, reading corner, nursery
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, Japandi
Materials: genuine sheepskin with long thick wool
Colors: creamy white, warm ivory
Shape: organic hide shape with irregular rounded edges, long fluffy fleece, small and light
Feel: cozy, soft, warm, natural
Goes with: light wood, linen, white walls, grey textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or rustic cabins and bedrooms
